name: Denisa-Elena Stolniceanu
title: Data Engineering & Cybersecurity
heroDescription: I am constantly expanding my knowledge in security operations, cybersecurity engineering, threat detection, incident response, cloud security, vulnerability management, identity security, and security automation.
summary: I am a Data Engineer with a strong interest in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and secure technology.
about: I am a Cybersecurity Master's student, actively expanding my knowledge in Defensive & Offensive Security, Cybersecurity Engineering, Cloud Security, and Vulnerability Management.
As a Data Engineer, I have a strong interest in Data Analysis, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Generative & Agentic AI.
I am also particularly interested in exploring the intersection between Cybersecurity and AI, including areas such as Agentic SOC and Agentic Red Teaming.
I continue developing my skills through hands-on labs, TryHackMe, Hack The Box, cloud security projects, and homelab environments.
I enjoy continuous self-learning and always seeking new ways to innovate, strengthen my skills, and grow through hands-on practice.

experience.title: Data Engineer in a Cybersecurity-focused team | AI & Security Automation
responsibilities: Selected to join the Cyber Security POD and work on internal Cyber Security initiatives supporting security maturity assessments, application security, vulnerability management, and secure software development processes.

Designed and developed an AI-powered VDR Data Cataloging Tool that processes and organizes multi-format document collections, generates summaries and semantic search, applies content-based governance tagging, maps documents to policies, and identifies coverage gaps to support OWASP SAMM assessments, due diligence, and faster document reviews.
Tested and reviewed the VDR Data Cataloging Tool using SonarQube, Burp Suite, Black Duck SCA, Gitleaks and Semgrep.
Conducted research for internal initiatives on Microsoft Purview, Wiz Cloud Security Platform, Claude Code sandboxing, Agentic SOC, and Agentic Red Teaming.
Participated in Endava's Security Champions Training Program and completed hands-on security training through the SecureFlag platform.

experience.title: Data Engineer - DavaX Academy
responsibilities: Completed a structured training programme covering Data & AI (Machine Learning, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, MLOps), Cloud technologies, Python Development, DevOps, Security Testing, and AI Testing.
After completing the programme, I joined the Data & AI discipline.

experience.title: Frontend Development Bootcamp
responsibilities: Designed and developed the frontend interface of a booking application wireframe, ensuring responsive web design.
Implemented responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Applied React.js concepts, DOM manipulation and UI/UX design principles.

experience.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer Intern
responsibilities: Collaborated in the development of ONG Manager, a full-stack application designed to help NGOs manage projects, events, volunteers and reporting activities.
Implemented backend functionalities using Java, Spring Boot, JPA and Hibernate integrated with PostgreSQL. Developed frontend components using Angular, Ionic, NgRx, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

projects.title: Microsoft Sentinel - SOC Operations
projects.description: Built a cloud-based SOC monitoring environment in Microsoft Azure using Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics Workspace, Data Collection Endpoint, Data Collection Rules, and Azure Monitor Agent. Validated telemetry with KQL, created analytics rules for failed RDP logins, suspicious PowerShell, SSH brute force, and impossible-location logins, and implemented SOAR workflows with Sentinel Playbooks and Logic Apps.

projects.title: Enterprise SOC Monitoring & Threat Detection HomeLab
projects.description: Built a virtual enterprise SOC lab using VMware, pfSense, Splunk Enterprise, Windows Server Active Directory, Windows Client, Kali Linux, Sysmon, and Splunk Universal Forwarder. Configured Windows and Sysmon telemetry collection and detection workflows mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

projects.title: BacHub - From Classical to Transformer-Based Techniques
projects.description: Cross-platform platform for classification, recommendation, and personalized test generation of Romanian Baccalaureate mathematics exercises. A curated dataset of over 19,000 exercises across 18 classes supported comparisons of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Transformer models; GRU with self-attention achieved 96.04% classification accuracy.
